    Galois covers of a ray category #

    A voltage V on a ray category P assigns to every morphism an element of a group H, multiplicatively on nonzero composites. The Galois cover GCover V has objects (y, h) with y : P, h : H; a nonzero morphism (y, h) ⟶ (z, h') is a nonzero f : y ⟶ z with h' = h · V(f), and composition is that of P (zero when the composite vanishes). It is a ray category, finite when P and H are (finite_gcover). Cancellation and chain-boundedness pass from P to the cover (leftCancel_gcover, rightCancel_gcover, chainBounded_gcover), and irreducible morphisms correspond (isIrreducible_val, isIrreducible_liftAt).
